typography.strategy: Technical & Sterile. Avoid standard SaaS fonts.
rules: Use font-mono for all changing data points (altitude, heading, etc.) to prevent layout shifts.
System labels (e.g., PANEL A, FUEL SYSTEM) must be uppercase with tracking-[0.2em] and text-xs or text-sm.
Never use Inter, Roboto, or generic sans for headings.
Use high-saturation accent blocks for active states and alerts.

visual_enhancers.borders: Prominent 1px solid borders on all panels and cards. Use grid borders (border-collapse style) for density.
visual_enhancers.shadows: None. Rely on borders and background contrast for depth. Tactical Minimalism: Replace soft shadows with 1px solid strokes.
visual_enhancers.textures: Clean solid colors. No gradients. No glassmorphism.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for dense, technical UI. (yarn add @phosphor-icons/react)

layouts.strategy: Bento Grid Protocol Mode B (High Density Grid) for Analytics/Admin
layouts.dashboard: 12 cards representing modules. Use locked/unlocked visual states (dimmed vs bright). Tight gap-4 or gap-6.
layouts.cognitive_updating: 6 aircraft panels (A-F) arranged in a 2x3 or 3x2 grid. Only 2 panels active/open at once. Active panels have bright borders and visible data, inactive are dimmed out.
layouts.system_logic: 15 system tabs arranged in a dense grid or side navigation. Only 2 open simultaneously. Show linked rules and troubleshooting logic.
layouts.admin_settings: Dense forms. Use pure HTML + Tailwind for layout, customized Shadcn for inputs/toggles. Align items to start.

motion.strategy: Minimal to none. Instantaneous feedback. No parallax, no heavy transitions. Only use instant color changes or 100ms fade for hover/active states. Represents professional, zero-latency military software.

accessibility.contrast: Strict WCAG AAA compliance for text. Ensure neon green and red are readable or paired with icons.
accessibility.focus: High contrast 2px solid ring on focus. MUST explicitly set text color on hover.
accessibility.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.

components.cards: Flat, bordered, no shadow. text-left. Use sharp edges, cardless or max 8px border-radius.
components.buttons: Sharp edges, 1px border. Hover state inverts background and text color.
components.tabs: Square, bordered tabs. Active tab gets a top border highlight (accent_highlight) and brighter background.

instructions_to_main_agent: You have .js files not .tsx file, so build components as .js/.jsx.
Install fonts: IBM Plex Sans and JetBrains Mono.
Set up Tailwind configuration with the custom color palette (#000022 to #000055 range).
Build the application as a strict Single Page App with a sidebar or topbar navigation for Dashboard and Admin.
For the Cognitive Updating module, manage state strictly to allow only 2 panels to be 'open' (displaying data) at any time. When a 3rd is clicked, close the oldest one.
For the System Logic module, implement the 15 tabs with the same 2-open-max rule.
Implement a robust settings context/store for Admin Settings (timers, difficulties) using LocalStorage.
Save all module results locally so performance history is tracked.
Include Practice mode and Assessment mode with a countdown timer.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: DO NOT apply universal transitions like 'transition: all'.
DO NOT center align the app container. Left-align dense data.
Use specific data-testid attributes on all interactive elements. Example: `data-testid='panel-a-toggle'`
Follow the exact color hex codes provided for the military CBT look. Do not deviate to standard gray/blue themes.
Use sonner for toast notifications if needed, placed in bottom-right.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
Use Phosphor icons. Command: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react
